L0: # List all Checkout Sessions
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.

L9: 
L10: Returns a list of Checkout Sessions.
L11: ## Request
L12: 
L13: ```curl
L14: curl -G https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions \
L15:   -u "<<YOUR_SECRET_KEY>>" \
L16:   -d limit=3
L17: ```

L104: ## Returns
L105: 
L106: A dictionary with a `data` property that contains an array of up to `limit` Checkout Sessions, starting after Checkout Session `starting_after`. Each entry in the array is a separate Checkout Session object. If no more Checkout Sessions are available, the resulting array will be empty.
L107: ## Parameters
L108: 
L109: - [`created`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/list.md?query=created) (object, optional)
L110:   Only return Checkout Sessions that were created during the given date interval.
L111: 
L112: - `customer` (string, optional)
L113:   Only return the Checkout Sessions for the Customer specified.
L114: 
L115: - `customer_account` (string, optional)
L116:   Only return the Checkout Sessions for the Account specified.
L117: - [`customer_details`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/list.md?query=customer_details) (object, optional)
L118:   Only return the Checkout Sessions for the Customer details specified.
L119: - `ending_before` (string, optional)
L120:   A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.
L121: 
L122: - `limit` (integer, optional)
L123:   A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
L124: - `payment_intent` (string, optional)
L125:   Only return the Checkout Session for the PaymentIntent specified.
L126: 
L127: - `payment_link` (string, optional)
L128:   Only return the Checkout Sessions for the Payment Link specified.
L129: - `starting_after` (string, optional)
L130:   A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.
L131: - `status` (enum, optional)
L132:   Only return the Checkout Sessions matching the given status.
L133: Possible enum values:
L134:   - `complete`
L135:     The checkout session is complete. Payment processing may still be in progress
L136: 
L137:   - `expired`
L138:     The checkout session has expired. No further processing will occur
L139: 
L140:   - `open`
L141:     The checkout session is still in progress. Payment processing has not started
L142: 
L143: - `subscription` (string, optional)
L144:   Only return the Checkout Session for the subscription specified.
